items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: They hire me and I got Max Kqminsky and I got Chippy Hill

ctx.x: So they were mad with me, and they ran me out. What they did was, they had a meeting, almost like I was in Russia and I was pulled before the board. And they said, he's got to go. And so I left the band, they replaced me, and I went back to New York. They weren't through with me, now that they were hot at me. So they offered me a job, again, another title, Young Women of America.

Obnoxious, I don't know who they are, but they give me a deposit, a union contract. They hire me and I got Max Kqminsky and I got Chippy Hill, I got -- and I go to the newspapers and I get a plug in the columns. In a week, I see an ad in the paper: The Young Women of America who so success-
fully produced the Paul Robeson concert in New Jersey. That was a riot in New Jersey, that concert. It was a big riot and a lot of problems.
